notes: τε and καί each take their own English conjunction, the ASV writing 'both ... and' (rule 70).

τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν leaves the article unrepresented under rule 20 proper, ἡμῶν being free to carry the possessive; τήν before μετάνοιαν is unrepresented because the ASV writes no determiner and supplies no relative clause (rules 23, 31).
